_comment: Same graph as `runtime_host_dominator_tree_shaken_import`, but `consumer.js` is also an entry. An imported entry module without side effects is in `load_dependencies` only to place the chunks. So `predicted_static_import_targets` follows the removed imports of `consumer.js` in `c.js` and `logger.js`, and a dominator search on those edges merges the runtime into the chunk of `consumer.js`. The kept-import rule counts such an entry only when the importer uses one of its bindings.
